locator: I q.9 a.1 co.: ex praemissis ostenditur Deum esse omnino immutabilem
interpretation: Aquinas shows God altogether immutable: (1) the first being is pure act, and whatever is changed is in some way in potency; (3) whatever is moved acquires something by its motion, but God, infinite and containing all fullness of perfection, cannot. The claim records the conclusion as Aquinas states it; CATHOLICISM-STAGE2-GOD-IS-IMMUTABLE derives it from the perfection result and the prima via's act-potency principles, combining these two reasons.
